title: Hamilton Gym Deals
meta_desc: Discover the best gym deals in Hamilton, NZ. Compare prices, contracts, and features. Get 40-70% off with Exercise NZ subsidy scheme.
intro: Hamilton's gym scene has grown significantly, with City Fitness and Les Mills operating in the city, and several boutique studios opening in recent years. Good value for money compared to the main centres. With various deals and promotions available, it's essential to compare prices and features before joining a gym.

sections.heading: Current Gym Deals in Hamilton
sections.body:
Several gyms in Hamilton are offering attractive deals and promotions. Jetts is providing 15% off and 4 weeks free, while Snap Fitness is offering 6 weeks free. Les Mills has introduced a Flexi Membership with no lock-in contract. City Fitness is offering a month-to-month membership for $18.99/week, which is considered the best value for a full-service gym.

Anytime Fitness is providing 24/7 access to over 5,000 clubs worldwide. F45 is offering a free trial week, and YMCA has a community membership with sliding scale pricing available.

sections.heading: Exercise NZ Subsidy Scheme
sections.body:
The Exercise NZ subsidy scheme offers 40-70% off gym memberships for eligible members, including new members or those who have been inactive for 12 months or more. This scheme can help make gym memberships more affordable and accessible to a wider range of people.

To be eligible for the subsidy, members must meet certain criteria, such as being a New Zealand citizen or resident, and not having been a gym member in the past 12 months.

sections.heading: Best Value Gyms in Hamilton
sections.body:
City Fitness is currently considered the best value gym in Hamilton, with a month-to-month membership available for $18.99/week. This membership includes access to a full range of equipment and facilities, as well as group fitness classes.

Les Mills is also a popular option, with a Flexi Membership available that includes access to group fitness classes and other amenities. However, prices for Les Mills memberships can vary depending on the specific membership package and contract length.

sections.heading: Money-Saving Tips for Joining a Gym in Hamilton
sections.body:
When joining a gym in Hamilton, there are several ways to save money. Firstly, consider taking advantage of the Exercise NZ subsidy scheme if you are eligible. Secondly, look for gyms that offer month-to-month memberships or no-contract options, as these can provide more flexibility and avoid long-term commitments.

Thirdly, compare prices and features between different gyms to find the best value for your needs and budget. Fourthly, consider joining a gym during off-peak hours or during promotions and discounts. Finally, be sure to read the fine print and understand the terms and conditions of your membership contract before signing up.
